column1: # Reviewed false positives for scripts/hygiene.py: <path glob> TAB <regex the whole hit must match> TAB <id in handbook/hygiene.md>
# B-FP-5: npm registry metadata in lock files lists package authors' public addresses (e.g. the npm founder's); not personal data of this project.
# B-FP-6: the ui Home screen lives in ui/src/home and ui/demo/src/home; module paths like ../home/layout are not host home directories.
# B-FP-7: random byte runs inside compressed PNG screenshots that happen to look like an address.
# B-FP-8: any PNG can contain byte runs shaped like an address; docs may name the ui Home routes.

# B-FP-9: the FB-3 mesh lab ran in an isolated, deleted VM; its logs carry the mesh range Headscale assigns (100.64.0.0/10, the documented default), the k3s default pod/service ranges and the lab VM user home. Mesh code and tests use that documented default prefix. None of it describes a real network.
